clean_room_scope: Clean-room GPGPU proxy acceptance for Ventus/Celviz integration. This does not claim Vivante proprietary command-stream, firmware, driver, SDK, conformance, or silicon signoff compatibility.
boundary_scope: Historical graphics-only artifacts are reference-only and cannot satisfy active Rank 1 GPGPU acceptance. Active evidence must be Rank 1 GPGPU artifacts or source implementation paths used by this clean-room proxy.

native_runtime_probe.behavior: Run native_runtime_build first in a no-space /tmp workspace, then run native_runtime_require_runtime when a matching shared library exists; otherwise report SKIP.

e1_fixture_evidence.scope: Runtime ABI command/evidence fixture metadata only; no runtime source code is used as fixture evidence.

e2_rtl_control_plane_evidence.scope: RTL source acceptance gate for the clean-room Ventus/Celviz GPGPU control plane. This is implementation-source evidence only and does not edit or claim proprietary Vivante RTL behavior.
required_observations: AXI4-Lite CSR storage for command/doorbell/completion/IRQ/error state.
RTL-visible queue progress via doorbell status/count plus command and completion counters.
APB/AXI read/write transaction counters and fire pulses preserved with dontTouch.
Scheduler host workgroup and CU wavefront handoff counters.
Top-level and warp scheduler debug bundles preserved with dontTouch.
e2_rtl_control_plane_evidence.pass_condition: The source checker finds every E2 RTL control-plane source check in active implementation files and rejects docs or verification prose as proof.

e3_native_runtime_evidence.scope: Native runtime acceptance evidence for the clean-room Ventus/Celviz GPGPU runtime proxy. This proves local build artifact presence, exported C ABI symbols, ctypes --require-runtime binding, queue and metric snapshots, ABI symbol coverage, and final pending-count closure.
required_observations: Build script emits a JSON manifest and JSONL log for the native runtime build or relink.
A non-empty libVentusRTL.so exists under /tmp/ventus-gpgpu-celviz-build after native_runtime_build.
nm-exported symbols include the required runtime bridge ABI plus queue, metric, pending-count, status-polling, and error-injection symbols.
runtime_cli --require-runtime records ctypes_bound runtime_bridge mode in both metrics and status outputs.
native_proxy_snapshot records queue snapshots, metric snapshots, ABI symbol coverage, and pending_count.
Final queue_totals.pending_count and summary.pending_count are zero.
e3_native_runtime_evidence.pass_condition: The E3 source and acceptance gates pass, and native --require-runtime output proves exported ABI coverage, queue/metric snapshots, and pending-count closure.

e4_demo_model_evidence.scope: Demo/model evidence gate for the clean-room OpenCL-like runtime and standard-library compute model. This proves local proxy workloads and golden data checks only; it is not proprietary Vivante/OpenCL conformance evidence.
required_observations: Kernel demo declares vector_add, gemm_proxy, image_filter, and memory_copy with queue dispatch sizes and global read/write buffer bindings.
The acceptance wrapper creates a temporary E4 kernel demo fixture with convolution_proxy when the checked-in demo fixture has not yet been regenerated by another worker.
Runtime queue trace records submit, wait, and readback phases for each demo workload with success completion and readback_sha256.

Demo outputs pass golden checks: vector_add result equals expected, memory_copy source/result hashes match, GEMM shape and image_filter metadata exist, and each result hash matches the summary golden hash.
Model outputs cover vector_add, gemm_proxy, convolution_proxy/image_filter, memory_copy, FP16 proxy metadata, FP32 operation metadata, and tier scaling metadata.
Runtime and model tier metadata provide monotonic FP16/FP32 operation scaling when sorted by shader-unit count.
e4_demo_model_evidence.pass_condition: The source checker accepts checked-in E4 evidence, and the acceptance wrapper accepts freshly generated runtime kernel-demo outputs against model/golden evidence.

e5_verification_evidence.scope: Verification evidence lane for command submission, interrupts, AXI traffic, reset behavior, invalid descriptors, DMA bounds/alignment, and throughput scaling by configured tier. This is clean-room proxy evidence only and does not add proprietary Vivante conformance claims.
required_observations: The current control-plane stream has 19 submitted commands, 19 completed commands, and each queue snapshot closes with submitted equal to retired.
Completion and error interrupt events are both present; current counters report completion_interrupts=13 and error_interrupts=3.
AXI traffic evidence token is true and current counters report read/write transactions plus bytes_read=736 and bytes_written=2272.
Reset evidence token is true and current counters record exactly one reset for the stream.
Expected invalid descriptors include ERR_SCHEDULER_FAULT, ERR_MMU_FAULT, and ERR_FENCE_WAIT.
Valid DMA/H2D/D2H commands are 16-byte aligned and inside declared memory regions; the expected MMU-fault descriptor is out of range.
Runtime configured tiers include at least four rows and runtime/model FP16/FP32 operation-rate metadata is monotonic after sorting by shader-unit count.
e5_verification_evidence.pass_condition: The verification command list exits 0, writes e5_verification_coverage: pass to test_results.log, the executable E5 control-plane fixture reports all E5 coverage bits true, the negative-boundary fixture records invalid descriptor, DMA bounds/alignment, reset pending/active, and command-submission error-record fields, and configured-tier throughput scaling remains monotonic in proxy evidence.

e6_integration_evidence.scope: E6 integration evidence for the clean-room Rank 1 Ventus/Celviz GPGPU proxy. This binds architecture, model, runtime, RTL control-plane, verification, and scaling evidence into one audit surface.

e8_verilator_coverage_evidence.scope: Supplemental E8 Verilator coverage evidence for the clean-room Ventus/Celviz GPGPU proxy. This gate records complex Verilator coverage artifacts and keeps RTL source/toggle/line coverage separate from functional coverage. It does not claim proprietary Vivante compatibility, official OpenCL conformance, production PPA, RTL timing closure, or silicon signoff.
required_observations: The coverage run script builds or relinks the Verilator model with coverage enabled, runs the clean-room Rank 1 workload set, and writes coverage.dat plus a human-readable coverage.info/report/run.log bundle.
RTL source, toggle, and line coverage are reported as structural Verilator metrics from the generated model and are not treated as functional correctness proof.

Functional coverage remains the acceptance-owned E1-E5 proxy evidence: command submission, queue closure, interrupts, AXI/APB traffic, reset behavior, invalid descriptors, DMA bounds/alignment, workload golden comparisons, and configured-tier scaling.

Functional coverage pass/fail is independent from RTL structural coverage percentages; 100% functional coverage means every declared clean-room functional coverage bin passed, not that every RTL line or toggle was covered.
The run log records the Verilator command, coverage output paths, workload manifest or command fixture, functional coverage bin summary, and clean-room/no-overclaim boundary.
e8_verilator_coverage_evidence.pass_condition: E8 passes only when the supplemental Verilator coverage script exits 0, coverage.dat and coverage.info are non-empty, report/index.html and run.log exist, run.log records the clean-room scope and the separation of RTL source/toggle/line coverage from functional coverage, and every declared functional coverage bin is PASS for an aggregate functional coverage result of 100%.
